mentions.h: TRACK & FIELD ROUND-UP — Vivian beats even time

photos.c: FRONT COVER: (Photo by Ed Lacey) Jim Vivian (38) matches world-record holder Paul Nash stride for stride in his heat of the A.A.A. 100 yds at White City. Both qualified in 10.1.
